6. Deep Learning: In deep learning, the algorithm learns a complex, hierarchical representation of the input data through multiple layers of neural networks. Examples include convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and recurrent neural networks (RNNs).

7. Ensemble Learning: In ensemble learning, the algorithm combines multiple models to improve the accuracy and robustness of the predictions. Examples include bagging, boosting, and stacking.
